_comment: Thresholds for scripts/startup_invariants_gate.sh. Structural per-record bounds are machine independent; the wall-time profile is machine local and names the stand it was measured on. Raising any value here is an INVARIANT CHANGE and needs OWNER GO (see ENGINEERING_INVARIANTS.md).

memory._max_vmhwm_comment: 640 MiB. Measured startup peak at 8.24M records: 592.6 MiB before MEM-002, 535 MiB after. Hard cgroup cap is 1 GiB with swap disabled.

boot._syscalls_comment: Baseline (4 KiB stdio) = 0.284 read syscalls per record (2 342 391 / 8.24M). Buffered sequential passes measure ~0.005. The gate fails at 0.05, i.e. an order of magnitude above the repaired figure and 5.7x below the defect.
boot._bytes_comment: Baseline 888 B/record (7.32 GB / 8.24M, three records.dat passes). After BOOT-001 (two passes) the expected figure is ~660 B/record. 780 fails long before a third pass can creep back in.

atlas-lab-sdb-hdd._comment: Measured 2026-11-16 on /dev/sdb (HDD) with MemoryMax=1G, MemorySwapMax=0, page cache evicted with posix_fadvise(DONTNEED). Identical code measured 2 228 s earlier under concurrent production I/O, so this profile is valid only for idle-stand measurements.
